## Episode Thesis

This is a personal-finance episode from the Rika Tillsammans channel about how much pension Swedes have in 2026. It breaks pension down into income pension, premium pension and occupational pension, compares median and average figures with the Swedish Pensions Agency's model case, and suggests measuring pension capital in monthly salaries. There is no stock-market or equity discussion. Companies come up only in ads or as pension providers, apart from the hosts' favourable view of the AP7 Såfa default fund, and the overall tone about the Swedish pension system is reassuring and positive.
